newsitem.title: MEXICO: Touring U.S. general wraps up Mexico visit.
newsitem.headline: Touring U.S. general wraps up Mexico visit.

text.p: U.S. General John Shalikashvili, on a week-long Latin American tour, wrapped up a visit to Mexico on Sunday after decorating its defence minister with one of his country's most prestigious honours.

Shalikashvili, chairman of the U.S. military's Joint Chiefs of Staff, Saturday conferred the Order of Military Merit on Mexican Defence Minister General Enrique Cervantes Aguirre before a parade of nearly 5,000 soldiers.

"(General Cervantes) has distinguished himself by the respect and affection he has shown towards our country and its men at arms at a time when bilateral cooperation was being decisively promoted," Shalikashvili said.
Mexico's defence ministry said Shalikashvili wanted to use the two-day visit to strengthen ties between the two nations' armed forces.
The U.S. general was due to travel on to Brazil, Argentina and Chile this week before returning home on July 26.
